units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:8">Targ. Lam. II, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:34">Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 34</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ top. v. <cite ref="A01339"><he>אִימִירָא</he></cite>. Esth. R. beg. <he>כד ילידת הוו מִתְאַבְּלִין</he> when the Empress gave birth, they (the Jews) mourned (it being the Ninth of Ab).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 59b:1">B. Kam. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>את חשיבא לאִתְאַבּוּלֵי וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. R. <he>לאַבּוּלֵי</he>, v. infra) art thou distinguished enough to wear mourning for Jerusalem?

senses.gloss: . Ib. <he>מְאַבֵּילְנָא</he> ed. (Ms. F. <he>מאבלנא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., note 6) I wear mourning.
